description: Builds a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoice: a PDF/A-3b page a person can read, with the EN 16931 XML embedded for software. Use it when the invoice goes to a person or by e-mail. For XML only, such as an XRechnung uploaded to a German public-sector portal, use create_invoice. Takes the same `invoice` object as create_invoice, money in integer minor units. `language` changes only the printed labels; the embedded XML is identical in every language. By default the PDF comes back as base64, which can be large; pass `outputPath` to write the file instead. Writing stays inside the server's working directory and never replaces an existing file unless `overwrite` is true. The same input always gives the same bytes, and nothing is sent anywhere. Check the result with validate_invoice (pass pdfBase64).

invoice.description: The invoice. Required: number, issueDate, currency, seller, buyer, lines.

items.description: BG-20 document level allowance (a discount) or BG-21 document level charge. Same shape, different array.

amountMinor.description: BT-92 document allowance / BT-99 document charge amount, always positive. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

baseAmountMinor.description: BT-93 / BT-100 base amount the percentage applies to. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

exemptionCode.description: Only needed to pick a breakdown when several share this category and rate but differ in exemption (VATEX code, BT-121).

exemptionReason.description: Only needed to pick a breakdown when several share this category and rate but differ in exemption (BT-120).

reasonCode.description: BT-98 / BT-105 reason code, UNTDID 5189 (allowance) or 7161 (charge).

taxCategory.description: BT-95 / BT-102 VAT category code of the allowance or charge.

taxRate.description: BT-96 / BT-103 VAT rate in percent of the allowance or charge.

attachments.description: BG-24 additional supporting documents, any number.

items.description: BG-24 additional supporting document: an attachment or a link.

content.description: BT-125 attached document, base64-encoded. Together with mimeCode and filename it is embedded.

mimeCode.description: BT-125-1 attached document MIME code, e.g. application/pdf.

url.description: BT-124 external document location (URL). Use this OR `content`.

businessProcess.description: BT-23 business process type. A plain string on purpose: France wants a closed list (B1, S1, M1, ...), Peppol and XRechnung want a profile URN. Each format decides what it accepts.

buyer.description: BG-7 buyer (with BG-8 postal address and BG-9 contact).

buyerReference.description: BT-10 buyer reference. For German public-sector invoices this is the Leitweg-ID (BR-DE-15).

currency.description: BT-5 invoice currency code, ISO 4217, e.g. EUR.

delivery.description: BG-13 delivery information with BG-15 deliver-to address.

country.description: BT-80 deliver-to country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

date.description: BT-72 actual delivery date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

locationIdScheme.description: BT-71-1 scheme of the location identifier.

dueDate.description: BT-9 payment due date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

invoicedObjectId.description: BT-18 invoiced object identifier (e.g. a meter or asset number).

invoicedObjectIdScheme.description: BT-18-1 scheme identifier of the invoiced object identifier.

issueDate.description: BT-2 invoice issue date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

lines.description: BG-25 invoice lines. At least one is required (BR-16).

items.description: BG-25 invoice line (with BG-29 price details, BG-30 line VAT information, BG-31 item information).
BG-27 line level allowance (a discount) or BG-28 line level charge. Same shape, different array.

amountMinor.description: BT-136 line allowance / BT-141 line charge amount, always positive. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

baseAmountMinor.description: BT-137 / BT-142 base amount the percentage applies to. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

reasonCode.description: BT-140 / BT-145 reason code, UNTDID 5189 (allowance) or 7161 (charge).

buyerAccountingReference.description: BT-133 invoice line buyer accounting reference.

items.description: BT-158 item classification identifier with its list and version.

scheme.description: BT-158-1 list identifier, e.g. STI, CPV, UNSPSC.

exemptionCode.description: BT-121 VAT exemption reason code, VATEX code list, e.g. VATEX-EU-AE.

exemptionReason.description: BT-120 VAT exemption reason text (for categories E, AE, K, G, O).

grossPriceMinor.description: BT-148 item gross price in minor units. When set together with BT-147, BT-146 must equal BT-148 - BT-147.

id.description: BT-126 invoice line identifier. Defaults to the 1-based position when absent.

netAmountMinor.description: BT-131 line net amount as stated in a document. Normally leave it UNSET: the net amount is computed from quantity, price and line allowances/charges. Set only to reproduce a document that states another value. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

objectIdScheme.description: BT-128-1 scheme identifier of the line object identifier.

orderLineReference.description: BT-132 referenced purchase order line reference.

originCountry.description: BT-159 item country of origin. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

periodEnd.description: BT-135 invoice line period end date (BG-26). ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

periodStart.description: BT-134 invoice line period start date (BG-26). ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

priceBaseUnitCode.description: BT-150 item price base quantity unit of measure code.

priceDiscountMinor.description: BT-147 item price discount in minor units (informational: BT-146 is already net).

quantity.description: BT-129 invoiced quantity, a decimal number (negative on a credit-note line is allowed). Read exactly, never as a binary float.

standardItemId.description: BT-157 item standard identifier, e.g. a GTIN. Needs standardItemIdScheme.

standardItemIdScheme.description: BT-157-1 scheme of the standard item identifier, e.g. 0160 for GTIN.

taxCategory.description: BT-151 invoiced item VAT category code (S, Z, E, AE, K, G, O, L, M).

taxRate.description: BT-152 invoiced item VAT rate in percent (19 for 19 %). Ignored for category O: BR-O-05 forbids a rate on a line "not subject to VAT". Use 0 for Z, E, AE, K, G, O.

unitCode.description: BT-130 invoiced quantity unit of measure, UN/ECE Recommendation 20. C62 = piece, HUR = hour, DAY = day, KGM = kilogram.

unitPriceMinor.description: BT-146 item NET price per unit in minor units. May be fractional (1.25 = 0.0125 in a two-decimal currency) because EN 16931 allows unit prices with more decimals than the currency.

subjectCode.description: BT-21 invoice note subject code. France requires AAB, PMD and PMT on every invoice.

orderReference.description: BT-13 purchase order reference. Peppol needs BT-10 or BT-13 (PEPPOL-EN16931-R003).

payee.description: BG-10 payee, when the party paid is not the seller.

idScheme.description: BT-60-1 scheme of the payee identifier.

legalIdScheme.description: BT-61-1 scheme of the payee legal registration identifier.

additionalAccounts.description: BG-17 can repeat: further accounts the buyer may pay into (the first one is iban/accountName/bic).

pan.description: BT-87 payment card primary account number: the LAST 4-6 DIGITS ONLY.

creditorId.description: BT-90 bank assigned creditor identifier (the seller's SEPA Glaeubiger-ID).

iban.description: BT-84 payment account identifier (IBAN) of the first account.

meansCode.description: BT-81 payment means type code, UNTDID 4461. 58 = SEPA credit transfer, 59 = SEPA direct debit, 30 = credit transfer, 48 = bank card.

reference.description: BT-83 remittance information: what the payer must quote on the transfer.

paymentTerms.description: BT-20 payment terms text. XRechnung uses a structured #SKONTO# syntax here for early-payment discounts.

periodEnd.description: BT-74 invoicing period end date (BG-14). ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

periodStart.description: BT-73 invoicing period start date (BG-14). ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

items.description: BG-3 preceding invoice reference. Needed in practice for credit notes (type 381).

issueDate.description: BT-26 preceding invoice issue date. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

prepaidMinor.description: BT-113 paid amount (prepayment already received). Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

roundingMinor.description: BT-114 rounding amount, added to the amount due (BR-CO-16). May be negative. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

seller.description: BG-4 seller (with BG-5 postal address and BG-6 contact).

additionalIds.description: BT-29 / BT-46 can repeat; these are the further identifiers (the first one is `id`).

additionalLegalInfo.description: BT-33, seller only. Legal form and capital, e.g. "SARL au capital de 10 000 EUR".

contact.description: BG-6 seller contact / BG-9 buyer contact. XRechnung makes the seller contact mandatory (BR-DE-2).

country.description: BT-40 seller / BT-55 buyer country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

electronicAddress.description: BT-34 seller / BT-49 buyer electronic address. Optional in EN 16931, MANDATORY in France, Peppol and XRechnung.

electronicAddressScheme.description: EAS code of the electronic address, e.g. EM (e-mail), 0088 GLN, 0204 Leitweg-ID, 0208 BE enterprise number, 9925 BE VAT. Defaults to EM only for a value containing "@".

legalId.description: BT-30 seller / BT-47 buyer legal registration identifier (e.g. SIREN, company number).

legalIdScheme.description: ISO 6523 ICD code for BT-30 / BT-47, e.g. 0002 SIREN, 0009 SIRET, 0208 BE enterprise number. Required when legalId is set.

name.description: BT-27 seller name / BT-44 buyer name (legal name).

street.description: BT-35 seller / BT-50 buyer address line 1.

taxRegistrationId.description: BT-32, seller only. Tax number where no VAT id exists, e.g. a German Steuernummer. BR-S-02 accepts BT-31, BT-32 or BT-63.

vatId.description: BT-31 seller / BT-48 buyer VAT identifier including the country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

statedVatAmounts.description: BT-117 per VAT breakdown (BG-23) as stated in a document. Normally leave unset: VAT amounts are computed. Set only to reproduce a source document's stated value; it is honoured only within one minor unit of the computed amount.

amountMinor.description: BT-117 VAT category tax amount as stated in a source document. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

category.description: BT-118 VAT category of the breakdown this stated amount belongs to.

exemptionCode.description: BT-121 exemption code, to pick the breakdown when several share category and rate.

exemptionReason.description: BT-120 exemption reason, to pick the breakdown when several share category and rate.

rate.description: BT-119 VAT rate in percent of that breakdown.

taxCurrency.description: BT-6 VAT accounting currency, when it differs from BT-5. Then taxTotalInTaxCurrencyMinor (BT-111) is mandatory (BR-53).

taxPointDate.description: BT-7 value added tax point date. Use this OR taxPointDateCode. ISO date yyyy-mm-dd.

taxPointDateCode.description: BT-8 value added tax point date code, UNTDID 2005: 3 invoice date, 35 delivery date, 432 paid-to-date.

taxRepresentative.description: BG-11 seller tax representative party, with its address BG-12.

country.description: BT-69 tax representative country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, FR.

vatId.description: BT-63 seller tax representative VAT identifier.

taxTotalInTaxCurrencyMinor.description: BT-111 invoice total VAT amount in the accounting currency. Needs an exchange rate, so the caller supplies it. Integer in minor units (cents): EUR 12.34 = 1234. Never a decimal.

typeCode.description: BT-3 invoice type code, UNTDID 1001. Default 380 (commercial invoice). 381 credit note, 384 corrected invoice, 389 self-billed invoice, 326 partial invoice, 875/876/877 partial/construction invoices. Credit-note codes are written as a UBL CreditNote.

language.description: Language of the printed labels: en, de or fr. Default en. Presentation only; the XML does not change.

outputPath.description: Write the PDF here instead of returning base64. Relative to the server working directory; must end in .pdf.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at outputPath. Default false.

name: create_invoice_pdf

byteLength.description: Size of the PDF in bytes.

conformanceLevel.description: Conformance level declared in the PDF metadata, e.g. EN 16931.

outputPath.description: Absolute path written, when outputPath was given.

pdfBase64.description: The PDF, base64. Absent when outputPath was given.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF bytes, hex; equal for equal input.

warnings.description: Non-fatal findings about the invoice data.

xmlFilename.description: Name of the embedded XML attachment.

title: Create a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF
